priceSnapshot.note: THE DAILY CANDLE CLOSED AT 69,338.1 AND THAT IS THE ONLY NUMBER THAT MATTERS TONIGHT. The 19 August UTC daily bar opened 64,727.8, ran to 70,038.9, held a 64,165.8 low from the pre-dawn flush and settled 69,338.1 - a 5,873.1 point range, 9.07 percent of the open, and the largest single-day range this file has ever recorded. More importantly it is the highest daily CLOSE since 1 June 2026, seventy-nine days ago, and it is the first daily close above the 200-period daily EMA in this entire down-leg. Midday published at 68,225.8 with the market in a bull flag under a ceiling it named precisely - a settled hourly close above 68,924.3, the daily ema200 as computed then - and said the long side was not a trade until that cleared. The 20:00Z hourly bar settled 69,049.5 and cleared it, the next settled 69,716.9, and price has spent the last four hours building a shelf between 68,983.1 and 70,038.9 rather than giving any of it back. The gate fired. Recomputed on tonight's 200-bar window the daily ema200 now reads 68,997.7 and price sits 576.0 points above it. Price is now above EVERY exponential moving average on every timeframe this report covers - 20, 50, 100 and 200 on the 15m, 1H, 4H and daily - which has not been true on a single run in this file's history.

overnightRisk: THE NEXT REPORT IS AT 02:00 COT AND THE GAP IS EIGHT HOURS WIDE ACROSS THE ASIA SESSION. Four specific things can happen inside it. FIRST, the ETF print completes. Farside's 19 August row currently reads plus 164.2 million dollars with BITB at 35.6, ARKB 77.7, MSBT 10.0, GBTC 21.2 and BTC 19.7 - but IBIT and FBTC, the two largest funds and together roughly 71.4 billion of the 52.5 billion net cumulative, are still dashes. IBIT alone printed 143.6 million yesterday and 160.2 the day before. If those two land positive the third-day streak becomes a large one and the Asia session gets a bid; if either prints negative it would say the institutional wrapper did not follow the SEC headline and the rally was equity-and-perp driven. That is the single largest scheduled unknown in the gap. SECOND, positioning has turned. The OKX long/short account ratio bottomed at 1.11 during midday's session and has climbed every hour since - 1.13, 1.13, 1.15, 1.15, 1.17, 1.14, 1.13 and 1.17 on the 00:00Z print. Open interest is 2,143,443,965 dollars against midday's 2,127,137,070, up 0.77 percent. The healthy phase of this move, where shorts were removed and no longs were added, is over; accounts are now long into a market that has already run 7.76 percent. That is the condition under which an Asian long flush happens, and the 69,100-69,199 band already holds 210,130 dollars of realized LONG liquidations from the 22:30Z dip - a proven pocket 400 points below spot. THIRD, the technical stretch. The 4H RSI is 86.2, the 1H is 82.4, the daily is 74.2 and the 15m MACD histogram has already rolled negative at -64.9 while price sits 4.9 percent above the 4H ema20. Daily ATR is 1,495.6, so an unremarkable overnight can retrace to 68,078 without touching the thesis. FOURTH, the crypto equities kept going after the cash close - MSTR settled 104.25 and traded 108.13 after hours, COIN settled 160.20 and traded 165.94 - which is confirmation while US desks are awake and becomes a vacuum once they are not. THE PLAN: a resting stop at 68,850.0 is the only protection that works while you are asleep. It sits 147.7 points under the reclaimed daily ema200 at 68,997.7, below the 68,983.1 shelf floor, and below the 68,900-68,999 pocket where 104,505 dollars of longs were already flushed - so it is under the sweep, not inside it. Losing it overnight is not a wick, it is the reclaim failing, and the whole ADD stance is wrong.

earnings.note: Strategy settled 104.25 for the regular session and traded 108.13 after hours, up 3.88 or 3.73 percent on the after-hours print at 7:59 PM EDT. Midday saw it at 103.44 intraday against a 92.52 previous close; it closed higher than that and then kept going after the bell. An equity with no perpetual-futures mechanics extending its gain into the after-hours session is the cleanest confirmation available that this is a repricing rather than a squeeze - and it is also the reason the overnight matters, because that bid disappears when US desks close.

Coinbase settled 160.20, up 13.97 or 9.55 percent against a 146.23 previous close, and traded 165.94 after hours, a further 5.74 or 3.58 percent at 7:59 PM EDT. The exchange equity and the treasury equity both closed near their highs and both extended afterwards, which is a consistent picture across two very different ways of expressing the same headline.

The Nasdaq-100 proxy closed 716.21, down 0.18 percent, its fourth down session in five - and it traded 719.00 after hours, up 0.41 percent. The divergence is the point: BTC put in a 9.07 percent range on a crypto-specific regulatory headline while the equity index it has tracked all month went nowhere. Today's move was not a risk-on session, it was a crypto session, and that makes it less dependent on equities overnight but also less supported by them.

calibration.note: The prior report is 2026-08-19-midday, published at 12:55:00-05:00 with spot at 68,225.8. RIGHT ANALYSIS, WRONG ACTION - and the report itself contained the correction. Its reduce line at 67,828.2 was touched to the tick by the 17:45Z 15m bar but never settled through on an hourly close, so priorReduceFired is false. Its add gate at 68,924.3 cleared decisively: the 20:00Z hourly bar settled 69,049.5 and the next settled 69,716.9, and price is now 649.4 points above the gate. Everything midday reasoned about the mechanism was correct - it said the daily ema200 was the only number that mattered, it named the exact level, it required a settled close, and that is precisely what happened four hours later. But its decisionBox said TAKE_PROFIT and it sold 0.00054232 BTC at 68,225.8. That BTC is worth 69,573.7 tonight, so the trim cost 0.73 USDT of foregone gain. Acting on the published stance hurt, and that is what actingHelped measures, so the grade is no. The redeeming detail, and the reason this run flips to ADD, is that midday wrote its own remedy into the wallet hand-off: 'if the daily settles above 68,924.3, that cash should go to work, not wait for a retest that a trend change will not give you.' The daily settled at 69,338.1. Twenty of the sixty USDT it raised has been deployed tonight on exactly that signal. The lesson is narrower than 'do not take profit': it is that taking profit into the moment your own analysis identifies as the pivot is the one place a trim is most expensive.
